verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a global fleet with selectable regions for deployments, explicitly to "meet data-residency needs" (docs-51), along with multi-region deployments (docs-67). It also offers a US-only Serverless mode that serves inference exclusively from the US for compliance (docs-46). Missing for 10: evidence that stored data (datasets, fine-tuning artifacts, logs) can be pinned to a chosen region rather than just inference location, a list of available regions or non-US serverless residency options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
